## Clarification needed

This issue is an **EPIC** that tracks several sub-issues for the Retinal Ganglion Cells refactoring effort. Looking at the task list:

- [x] #3176 — completed
- [ ] #3177 — synaptic IO and morphology (mono vs bis-stratified) representation
- [ ] #3178 — completed (midget ON/OFF and parasol ON/OFF)
- [ ] #3179 — mouse RGC nomenclature

The EPIC itself does not specify actionable edits — the concrete work lives in the linked sub-issues. The two remaining open items (#3177 and #3179) each describe substantial scoping/representation work (formalising morphology and synaptic-IO axioms; reconciling multiple mouse RGC nomenclatures).

Could you clarify which sub-issue you would like addressed here? No ontology changes have been committed pending clarification.
